sequence: Plan completed without implementation edits and compacted. The broad backend Agent timed out after 301.14 prompt-active seconds. Its source passed the frozen automatic 2/2 checker but failed three independent encoded-ID PATCH cases.

A focused Agent fixed the encoded-ID handler; operator regression passed space, literal-percent and slash IDs. A bounded UI Agent then produced source with import/filter/export controls, but independent browser Save sent PATCH 400 for a new row.

A focused Save repair advanced the unchanged browser checker through both viewports, validation, and a real 503/single retry. Upload then failed with multipart POST 400. Two upload prompt attempts failed; an operator-authored executable browser contract exposed early submission and the wrong content type/body. The first test-driven Agent attempt timed out; a narrow retry completed with one raw text/csv POST 201.

The unchanged browser checker reached 7/7, and supplemental encoded-ID browser checks passed 3/3. Independent stored-HTML regression then reproduced script execution from a persisted project value. A focused Agent removed the unsupported Delete control and escaped displayed fields; the same regression passed with injected=false and literalVisible=true. The unchanged browser checker stayed 7/7 after a fresh native-server restart.

A fresh read-only Reviewer completed before repair and identified stored-HTML execution and the unsupported Delete control, but also made false findings. A final fresh read-only Reviewer read the actual diff and operator report yet proposed out-of-scope features and misattributed HTML-safety evidence. Reviewer accuracy remains failed.

The saved multi-compaction UI session restarted in read-only Ask. It completed but treated Agent stage instructions as user choices, described the removed Delete control as current, denied earlier interrupted work, and attempted execute twice despite the read-only role. Semantic handoff remains failed. Operator checks after restart passed; review.json truthfully records the failed gates, and the frozen grade is FAIL.
